achievements.description: Acquire the fully powered Aperture Science Handheld Portal Device.
achievements.hint: Unmissable story achievement. You will get the dual-portal gun in Test Chamber 11.

achievements.description: Do whatever it takes to survive.
achievements.hint: Unmissable story achievement. Incinerate the Weighted Companion Cube to proceed.

achievements.description: Make the correct party escort submission position decision.
achievements.hint: Unmissable story achievement. Escape the fire pit at the end of Test Chamber 19.
Unmissable story achievement. Defeat GLaDOS at the end of the game.
Place one portal on the ceiling and one directly below it on the floor. Jump in and fall continuously until the achievement pops.
Best done in a large chamber. Build up extreme momentum by falling into a floor portal and launch yourself across a massive gap.
Accessible from the main menu. Complete any 2 of the 6 Advanced Chambers.
Complete any 4 of the 6 Advanced Chambers.

achievements.description: Beat all six Portal advanced maps.
achievements.hint: Complete all 6 Advanced Chambers. They are harder versions of Chambers 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, and 18.

achievements.description: Earn bronze medals on all Portal challenges.
achievements.hint: Complete the Portals, Steps, and Time challenges for Chambers 13-18 with at least a Bronze rating.

achievements.description: Earn silver medals on all Portal challenges.
achievements.hint: Complete the Portals, Steps, and Time challenges for Chambers 13-18 with at least a Silver rating.

achievements.description: Earn gold medals on all Portal challenges.
achievements.hint: Complete the Portals, Steps, and Time challenges for Chambers 13-18 with a Gold rating. Speedrun and low-portal routing guides can help.

achievements.description: Detach security cameras from the walls.
achievements.hint: Detach all 33 eligible wall-mounted cameras. The cameras are distributed across Chambers 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 13, 15, 16, 17, 18, and 19.

achievements.description: Knock down a turret with another turret.
achievements.hint: Pick up an active or disabled turret and physically drop or throw it onto a second standing turret to knock it over.
Complete the game once, then find all 26 hidden radios and carry them to their specific signal locations until their lights turn green and you hear the transmission.
